title: Self-Gravitation of Mode Quanta in a Causal Resonator: One-Loop Finiteness in Linearized Quantum Gravity and the Emergence of the Dark-Energy Scale
summary: Perturbative quantum gravity is ultraviolet divergent and, as shown by 't Hooft and Veltman, non-renormalizable. A recent object-relative, Lorentz-invariant weighting of internal electromagnetic modes renders selected one-loop contributions of quantum electrodynamics finite without counterterms. Here that weighting is derived rather than postulated: causality defines a mode resonator bounded by the Hubble radius and re-defined in every inertial frame, and the self-gravitation of each mode quantum deforms its spectrum.
